method: Full production brief and resources decoded from NextJS RSC HTML strings; requirements below are paraphrases.
core_objectives: Identify Earth science variables suitable for investigating trends.
Acquire data for a selected region.
Visualize a sufficiently long time series for the variable and region.
Estimate the rate and assess significance, for example through confidence intervals.
scope: Basic linear trend analysis satisfies the envisaged statistical scope; more complex trend analysis is not required.
optional_suggestions: Define variables for high-school/college users and interested public.
AI may assist discovery but is not required.
name_collision: An existing KNMI product has the same Climate Explorer name. This project must identify itself as an independent student prototype, with no claim of affiliation or naming originality.
